summary: Tested Share functionality on DocumentDetail screen, /help FAQ flow, and backend PDF export endpoint. DocumentDetail Share bottom-sheet modal works correctly — all 4 options (share-as-pdf-btn, share-as-image-btn, share-as-text-btn, share-more-formats-btn) render and the 'More Formats…' option opens the export sheet. Modal dismisses via Escape and close icon. /help screen loads independently with FAQ expand/collapse and category switching all functional. Backend POST /api/documents/{id}/export?format=pdf returns valid base64 PDF (verified %PDF magic bytes). Could NOT functionally test preview-share-btn (requires completed scan workflow) and could NOT verify Profile→Help nav via UI because /profile gates auth and provided test creds returned 401 — both verified by static code review only. Console shows React Native warnings: deprecated 'textShadow*'/'shadow*' style props and 'Unexpected text node . cannot be a child of a <View>' errors across screens (non-blocking but should be cleaned).

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify the help-faq-row tap-through end-to-end via UI because /profile redirects unauthenticated users to /auth and the test credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md returned 401 on Sign In. testID and router.push('/help') exist in source (profile.tsx ~line 494). Needs main-agent verification with valid auth.

Could not exercise the preview share button via web automation — it requires a live camera scan completion path. Source review confirms the testID exists, the button is gated on analysis completion (disabled while analyzing) and triggers Share.share when tapped. Recommend manual on-device QA or a stubbed analysis state for E2E.

issues: Console emits repeated 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' errors on dashboard and document detail — stray whitespace/conditional rendering outside a <Text> in a View. Should be tracked down (likely a `{condition && ' '}` or trailing space in JSX).
Deprecated React Native Web style props 'textShadow*' and 'shadow*' used in styles — migrate to combined 'textShadow' / 'boxShadow' properties to silence warnings.

action_items: Manually (or with valid auth seed) verify the Profile → Help/FAQ tap navigation end-to-end; the wiring exists in code but UI auth gate blocked automated coverage.
Manually verify on a real scan that preview-share-btn becomes enabled after analysis completion and that Share.share fires successfully (couldn't be reached via headless web).
Investigate and fix the recurring 'Unexpected text node' RN web error (likely stray string/whitespace inside a <View> not wrapped in <Text>).
Update test credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md or fix seed so test users authenticate successfully — current creds returned 401 from /api/auth/login.
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentDetail share modal correctly disables 'Share as Image' when doc.image_thumbnail is missing — good defensive UX (shows 'No image available').

Share-as-PDF path writes base64 from /api/documents/{id}/export to cache and invokes expo-sharing — works on native but expo-sharing has limited web support; ensure graceful fallback warning on web preview.

success_rate.frontend: Share modal 100%; FAQ 100%; Profile→Help & preview share NOT verified end-to-end (code-review only)
